data.title: Sunderland Remain Behind Régis Le Bris After Falling to Bottom Place - Telecom Asia Sport
data.content: # Sunderland Remain Behind Régis Le Bris After Falling to Bottom Place. **Sunderland keeps supporting head coach Régis Le Bris despite sitting bottom of the Premier League with five points from nine matches.**. The club’s position follows a 3-1 defeat at Coventry City on October 31. Le Bris acknowledged that Sunderland was in a relegation battle. The coach was booed by fans at half-time and at full-time and stated that this reaction was normal. Sunderland’s only league victory came against Fulham in August. They finished seventh in 2025-26, their first season back in the Premier League after promotion. Sunderland host Dinamo Zagreb in the Europa League at the Stadium of Light on November 5, with kick-off scheduled for 20:00 GMT.
